info.title: KabadOS API
info.description: Verified scrap marketplace API. Every POST needs an `Idempotency-Key` header.

post.summary:
Records the OTP channel preference before a resend (PLAN.md §5.1). OTP
delivery is currently disabled; the preference is stored for when it's on.
`POST /v1/calls/{id}:join | :end`.
Opens a dispute; the deal waits for ops (PLAN.md §13.5).
Pickup evidence photos (items as found, scale display) by vendor or transporter.
Offers the pickup to the vendor's transporters (PLAN.md §7.5).

`POST /v1/deals/{id}/lines/{n}:regrade` (vendor/transporter) and
`:accept-regrade` / `:remove` (seller), PLAN.md §13.5.
Vendor requests payment: seller amount + transporter fare + platform fee.

Razorpay Checkout success handler: the signature proves the payment, so
the deal advances even before the webhook arrives (idempotent with it).
AI reads the scale display (PLAN.md §11.8); on low confidence the driver types the value.

Records a scale reading; when every line is weighed the final amount is
computed by `kabados-pricing` and the seller is asked to confirm.

`POST /v1/deals/{id}:schedule | :arrive | :confirm-weights | :mark-paid-direct |
:confirm-received | :handover | :confirm-delivery | :cancel | :no-show`.

get.summary: Drive details for the join page (link or QR).
Drive report: kg by category, hazardous kg to authorized vendors, participation.

post.summary: `POST /v1/drives/{id}:join` (resident attaches a listing) and `:close` (admin).
Checklist step: each is timestamped and GPS-tagged (PLAN.md §8.4).
Batched GPS → Amazon Location tracker; only while the job shares location.
`POST /v1/jobs/{id}:accept | :decline`.

get.summary: Listing detail; what is shown depends on who is asking (PLAN.md §7.3, §18).

patch.summary: Edits; a published listing gets a new version (quotes and offers are per version).

post.summary: `POST /v1/listings/{id}/claims/{claimId}:contest`: vendors then see "seller disputes AI assessment".

patch.summary:
Seller edits, adds, splits or merges items (PLAN.md §6.1 step 3–4). The
system never overwrites the seller's weight; hazard flags come from the taxonomy.

get.summary: The vendor's deterministic quote from their rate card (offer pre-fill).
Seller: all offers on the listing. Vendor: their own offers on it.

post.summary: Attaches camera photos to a proof request and re-runs verification.
`POST /v1/listings/{id}/proofs:skip`: the seller can always skip to READY.
`POST /v1/listings/{id}:analyze | :publish | :withdraw`.

delete.summary:
Erasure (DPDP): removes addresses, payout methods and devices, and
anonymizes the profile; financial records are kept under legal hold.

post.summary: Records a DPDP consent decision (separate, withdrawable per purpose).
DPDP data export: everything stored about the caller, decrypted for them.
Adds a UPI ID and validates it before the first payout (PLAN.md §6.3).

`POST /v1/me/roles/{role}:apply`. KYC verification is skipped by product
decision: applications are approved immediately.
`POST /v1/offers/{id}:accept | :counter | :reject | :withdraw`.

get.summary: Low-confidence assessments, failed-closed analyses and contested verdicts.
Evidence timeline per deal: photos, scale readings, GPS, payments, audit.

post.summary: `POST /v1/ops/disputes/{dealId}/{disputeId}:resolve`.
`POST /v1/ops/kyc/{userId}:approve | :reject`.

get.summary: Full listing view for AI review (ops never see the exact address).

post.summary: `POST /v1/ops/users/{userId}:suspend | :unsuspend`.

get.summary: Kabad Rate Index: weekly medians, published only above k-anonymity thresholds.
Green Receipt verification by signed ID.

post.summary: Server-side moderation, then delivery on `thread/{id}` (PLAN.md §17.2).

put.summary: "On duty" toggle; only on-duty transporters receive offers (PLAN.md §8.4).
Registers the device for push (SNS → FCM) and records its integrity verdict.

get.summary: Incoming job offers (approximate area only until accepted).

post.summary:
Unlocks hazardous categories. Verification is skipped by product decision
(accepted on upload); expiry is still enforced and auto-locks categories.

get.summary: Browse all published listings near the yard (approximate locations only).

parameters.name: ring
parameters.description: Ring of r7 cells around the yard (0–3).

post.summary: Saves the form editor's draft; validation issues are returned, not blocking.
`POST /v1/vendor/rule-sets/{id}/versions/{v}:simulate | :publish`.
Bulk change, e.g. "all metals +3% from tomorrow 9am" (PLAN.md §7.2).

Drafts rules from a typed instruction with the rules-authoring agent
(PLAN.md §11.7). Nothing publishes until the vendor taps Publish.

get.summary: "My transporters", ranked by ETA (Amazon Location route matrix), rating and fit.

parameters.name: deal_id
parameters.description: Rank by ETA to this deal's pickup point.

post.summary: Adds a transporter (who has signed up in the app) to the vendor's trusted list.

oneOf.description: Optional slot override chosen by the seller from the vendor's proposal.

ApproxLocation.description: Approximate location vendors may see before a deal (PLAN.md §20.2).

center.description: Centre of the r7 cell, never the exact point.

AttrValue.description: Item attribute values used by rule-line conditions.

attendee.description: Chime `Attendee` object (join token) for this caller.

meeting.description: Chime `Meeting` object for the client SDK.

emission_factor_g_per_kg.description: Grams CO2e avoided per kg recycled (estimate, PLAN.md §11.11).

weight_tolerance_pct.description: Seller-estimate tolerance used for quote ranges (PLAN.md §12.3 step 3).

contested.description: Seller says the AI is wrong; vendors see "seller disputes AI assessment".

razorpay_key_id.description: Razorpay public key for Checkout (test key in non-prod).

oneOf.description: Final seller amount from scale readings (`kabados-pricing`).

handover_otp_hash.description: Keyed hash of the handover OTP; the plain code is shown only to the seller.

handover_otp.description: Seller-only, after payment (Mode A) or receipt confirmation (Mode B).

resume_status.description: Deal status to return to on resolution.

instruction.description: e.g. "copper 650, brass 400, paper 14 above 5 kilo, no glass"

join_code.description: Join code embedded in the link/QR.

oneOf.description: Asking price for the whole lot, with a reason (PLAN.md §6.1 step 5).

clear_asking_price.description: Clears the asking price (accept the suggestion instead).

FareTemplate.description: Fare agreed per job: fixed, or per-km template (PLAN.md §7.5).

GreenReceipt.description: Green Receipt: platform record of a completed pickup (not an EPR certificate, PLAN.md §20.3).

ai_category_id.description: Category the AI proposed, to measure acceptance (PLAN.md §2 #1).

oneOf.description: Seller's estimate (required before publish; the system never overwrites it).

ladder.description: Strongest supported ladder level over this item's claims.

oneOf.description: Seller's estimate for the whole line (required before publishing).
Existing item to keep (AI fields are preserved when the category is unchanged).

device_at.description: Device time, kept to compare against server time (PLAN.md §14).

JobEventKind.description: Typed checklist events posted by the transporter app (`POST /v1/jobs/{id}/events`).

extracted.description: Values extracted by Textract (field → text), numbers redacted.

LadderLevel.description: How much evidence supports a claim. Ordered from weakest to strongest.

ListingSummary.description: Listing fields safe for any viewer allowed `ViewListing`.

weight_notes.description: Seller-only: estimates outside the plausible range (soft notes).

edits.description: Per-line rate edits away from the rate card (logged).

MatchLead.description: A first-look lead written by the matching worker (PLAN.md §7.3).

oneOf.description: ₹ per km beyond `free_km` (road distance from the yard).
+bonus% when the lot's weight in `category_glob` reaches `threshold_g`.
Deduction per floor when no lift is available.

city.description: Optional; derived by reverse geocoding when absent.

transporter_ids.description: Ranked transporters (sequential offers go down this list on timeout/decline).

oneOf.description: For FARE_CHANGED: the new fare agreed on a call.
Who is rated when the caller is the vendor (seller or transporter).

link.description: Deep link path in the relevant client, e.g. `/listing?id=…`.

distance_m.description:
Road distance yard → pickup used for the quote; settlement reuses it so
the distance deduction can't drift between offer and payment.

edited.description: True when the vendor edited the rate away from their rate card (logged, PLAN.md §7.4).

modifier_pct.description: Verification modifier percentage applied to this line (+bonus / −discount).

meets_ask.description: Quote meets the seller's asking price (highlighted to the seller, PLAN.md §12.6).

oneOf.description: Required when the seller opens a thread with a vendor who offered.

key_id.description: Public key for Razorpay Checkout on the client.

simulated.description: True when created by the mock adapter (clients complete it via the dev endpoint).

Paise.description: Indian rupee amount in paise (1 ₹ = 100 paise).

adult_confirmed.description: Must be true to use the service (18+ only, PLAN.md §5.3).

PaymentMode.description: Mode A (platform-mediated) or Mode B (direct), PLAN.md §13.2.

floor.description: Floor the items are on (0 = ground).

sha256.description: Base64 SHA-256 of the file; enforced by S3 on upload.

headers.description: Headers the client must send verbatim (content type, length, checksum).

coverage_permille.description: Covered items / all items, in per-mille (integer for determinism).

rule_line.description: Index of the matched rule line; `None` when an agreed rate was used.

Rate.description: Rate for one line: per kg or per piece.

verify_path.description: Shareable verification link path for the public site.

oneOf.description: Deal status to continue from (defaults to the status before the dispute).

Role.description: Roles are attributes of a single account (PLAN.md §3).

source.description: How the draft was produced (form, text instruction, bulk change).

RuleSetInput.description: Rule set body as edited in the form (IDs, version and status are server-set).

ambiguities.description: Questions to confirm ("Does 'paper' mean newspaper only?").

far_from_index.description: Lines priced far from the Rate Index (±40%), needing confirmation.

Sealed.description: Ciphertext of a field-level encrypted attribute (PLAN.md §16.2). Opaque to the domain.

UserId.description: A KabadOS user (one account can hold several roles).

oneOf.description: AI reading (PLAN.md §11.8) and the confirmed value.
